name: Church of the Holy Family
notes: No weekday Mass on public holidays; Mass is at 9.30am instead.
Confession is available 30 minutes before all weekend Masses.

info.adoration: Adoration Room open daily 6am-10.30pm. First Friday Adoration at 7pm.
good_to_know: For Last Rites or urgent care for the seriously ill, call 6344 0046 to reach the priest on duty.
Katong Catholic Shop: Tues-Fri 12 noon-6.30pm, Sat-Sun 8.30am-5.30pm; closed Mondays and public holidays.
Columbarium open daily 6am-10pm; lift hours daily 9am-7pm, public holidays 8.30am-12 noon.
Weddings: apply at the Parish Office at least one year in advance.
